_note: Two Baidu photos of the departure-gate area and the terminal hall, published alongside the Esri World Imagery satellite view.

kwi-baidu-1.webp.zh: 科威特机场出发登机区的排队通道：旅客在黄色隔离带间等候，上方是显示各航班状态的航班信息屏。
kwi-baidu-1.webp.en: The queue lanes at Kuwait International Airport's departure gates — passengers waiting between yellow barriers beneath flight information screens.

kwi-baidu-2.webp.zh: 科威特国际机场航站楼大厅：入口墙上用阿拉伯文和英文写着机场名称，旅客拖着行李穿行其间。
kwi-baidu-2.webp.en: The terminal hall at Kuwait International Airport — the airport's name in Arabic and English above the entrance as travellers pass with their luggage.

kwi-sat-1.webp.zh: 从卫星图看，科威特国际机场（KWI）的机场布局与周边环境清晰可辨。
kwi-sat-1.webp.en: In the satellite image, the layout of Kuwait International Airport (KWI) and its surroundings are clearly visible.
